---
title: "Image Classification: Trash, Recycling, Compost"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reticulate)
library(caret)
library(torch)
library(luz)
```

```{r}
# load images and labels
np <- import("numpy")
imgs <- np$load("npy_and_labels_200/images.npy")
labels <- read.csv("npy_and_labels_200/labels.csv", header = FALSE)

# normalize images
imgs <- imgs / 255

# labels
y <- as.integer(labels$V1)
set.seed(42)

# split: 70% trainval, 30% test
indices <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
x_trainval <- imgs[indices, , , ]
y_trainval <- y[indices]
x_test <- imgs[-indices, , , ]
y_test <- y[-indices]

# split trainval into 80% train, 20% validation
val_indices <- createDataPartition(y_trainval, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
x_train <- x_trainval[val_indices, , , ]
y_train <- y_trainval[val_indices]
x_valid <- x_trainval[-val_indices, , , ]
y_valid <- y_trainval[-val_indices]

# convert to torch tensors
x_train <- torch_tensor(x_train)$permute(c(1, 4, 2, 3))$to(dtype = torch_float())
x_valid <- torch_tensor(x_valid)$permute(c(1, 4, 2, 3))$to(dtype = torch_float())
x_test  <- torch_tensor(x_test)$permute(c(1, 4, 2, 3))$to(dtype = torch_float())

y_train <- torch_tensor(y_train + 1L)$to(dtype = torch_long())
y_valid <- torch_tensor(y_valid + 1L)$to(dtype = torch_long())
y_test  <- torch_tensor(y_test + 1L)$to(dtype = torch_long())

train_ds <- tensor_dataset(x_train, y_train)
valid_ds <- tensor_dataset(x_valid, y_valid)
test_ds  <- tensor_dataset(x_test, y_test)

train_dl <- dataloader(train_ds, batch_size = 32, shuffle = TRUE)
valid_dl <- dataloader(valid_ds, batch_size = 32)
test_dl  <- dataloader(test_ds, batch_size = 32)

# data augmentation
train_transforms <- function(x, y) {
  img <- as_array(x$permute(c(2, 3, 1)))
  if (runif(1) > 0.5) {
    img <- img[, ncol(img):1, ]
  }
  x <- torch_tensor(img)$permute(c(3, 1, 2))
  list(x, y)
}

train_ds_aug <- dataset(
  initialize = function(images, labels) {
    self$images <- images
    self$labels <- labels
  },
  .getitem = function(i) {
    x <- self$images[i, ..]
    y <- self$labels[i]
    train_transforms(x, y)
  },
  .length = function() self$images$size()[[1]]
)(x_train, y_train)

train_dl <- dataloader(train_ds_aug, batch_size = 32, shuffle = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Define CNN model
cnn_model <- nn_module(
  initialize = function() {
    self$conv1 <- nn_conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$pool1 <- nn_max_pool2d(2)
    self$conv2 <- nn_conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$pool2 <- nn_max_pool2d(2)
    self$conv3 <- nn_conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$pool3 <- nn_max_pool2d(2)
    self$conv4 <- nn_conv2d(128, 128, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$pool4 <- nn_max_pool2d(2)

    self$flattened_size <- 128 * 14 * 14
    self$fc1 <- nn_linear(self$flattened_size, 512)
    self$dropout <- nn_dropout(p = 0.6)  # increased dropout
    self$fc2 <- nn_linear(512, 7)
  },
  forward = function(x) {
    x %>%
      self$conv1() %>% torch_relu() %>% self$pool1() %>%
      self$conv2() %>% torch_relu() %>% self$pool2() %>%
      self$conv3() %>% torch_relu() %>% self$pool3() %>%
      self$conv4() %>% torch_relu() %>% self$pool4() %>%
      torch_flatten(start_dim = 2) %>%
      self$fc1() %>% torch_relu() %>% self$dropout() %>%
      self$fc2()
  }
)
```

```{r}
# train model with Luz
model <- cnn_model

fitted <- model %>%
  setup(
    loss = nn_cross_entropy_loss(),
    optimizer = optim_adam,
    metrics = list(luz_metric_accuracy())
  ) %>%
  fit(
    train_dl,
    valid_data = valid_dl,
    epochs = 50,
    callbacks = list(
      luz_callback_early_stopping(
        monitor = "valid_loss",
        patience = 5,
        min_delta = 0.001,
        mode = "min"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# evaluate test set performance
metrics <- fitted %>% evaluate(test_dl)
print(metrics)

# predictions and confusion matrix
preds <- predict(fitted, test_dl)
pred_classes <- torch_argmax(preds, dim = 2)$to(dtype = torch_int()) - 1L
true_classes <- y_test$to(dtype = torch_int()) - 1L

pred_r <- as.integer(as_array(pred_classes))
true_r <- as.integer(as_array(true_classes))

levels <- 0:6
pred_r <- factor(pred_r, levels = levels)
true_r <- factor(true_r, levels = levels)

cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_r, true_r)
print(cm)

cm_data <- as.data.frame(as.table(cm$table))
colnames(cm_data) <- c("Prediction", "Reference", "Frequency")
class_labels <- c("Cardboard", "Compost", "Glass", "Metal", "Paper", "Plastic", "Trash")

ggplot(cm_data, aes(x = Prediction, y = Reference, fill = Frequency)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d", Frequency)), color = "white", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix: Trash, Recycling, Compost",
       x = "Predicted Class", y = "True Class") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = class_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = class_labels) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
# plot accuracy and loss over epochs
history <- fitted$records

train_metrics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(fitted$records$metrics$train), function(i) {
  rec <- fitted$records$metrics$train[[i]]
  data.frame(
    epoch = i,
    train_loss = rec$loss,
    train_accuracy = rec$acc
  )
}))

ggplot(train_metrics, aes(x = epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train_accuracy, color = "Accuracy"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train_loss, color = "Loss"), size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Training Loss & Accuracy Over Epochs",
       x = "Epoch", y = "Value") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Accuracy" = "blue", "Loss" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
